title: Explicit unknown tier policy
spec: Implement quota(tier) for a string tier. Return 10 for basic and 100 for premium. For every other string, raise ValueError. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.
target_defect: Unknown tiers silently receive a quota rather than raising ValueError.
author_rationale: The change centralizes named quotas in a lookup table.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
